title: The narrow Neumann bounds on this section are 5776, 200144176, and 5776*sqrt(34651) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the normalized Schur section on `0,1,2,7,8,9` meets the pinned narrow Neumann hypotheses with survivor bandwidth `b=3` and `rho=5775/5776`.
- The lemma's right-hand sides are `||H^{-1}||_infinity <= 5776`, `||H^{-1}||_1 <= 200144176`, and `||H^{-1}||_2 <= 5776*sqrt(34651)`. The integer `34651` is prime.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This applies the pinned lemma to one section; it does not prove the Neumann series.
